title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
方言想到这里，看向文泰来的目光就变得柔和许多。呵呵，文泰来，你也嚣张不了多久了，等到了西北，出了塞，你就会被清廷走狗追杀，抓住，囚禁，拷问，不死也得脱层皮。方言不打算提醒文泰来注意，一来是因为解释不了他为什么能预知未来，二来是因为以文泰来刚愎自用的性格，绝对不会听劝，所以方言就没有费那个事儿。此行北上的目的地是塞外，从甘肃安西镇向西北而行，去往西域。经过了近一个多月的风餐露宿，跋山涉水，赶了两千多公里，穿越了大半个国家，才堪堪进入甘肃兰州境内。一想到还要穿过甘肃那个狭长的版图，方言就有些绝望。他从来都没想过，在古代赶路居然是这么痛苦的一件事。一天最多只能跑个两百里左右，不然马力吃不消。想象中的马踏江湖的豪情，全都化作了赶路投宿的疲惫。方言也很是惭愧，虽然武功高过了同行的文泰来夫妇，但是论起吃苦耐劳，自己却连骆冰都比不过。就这，骆冰还经常夸赞鼓励方言，说像他这么优秀的年轻人不多了！刚进兰州地界儿，方言就和骆冰夫妇分开。他们二人要去寻找红花会其他几个当家的踪迹，方言则负责去找客栈投宿，补充干粮水袋。在客栈中枯坐许久，也不见二人归来。方言等的心急，牵着马就出门寻找。在兰州城中走了没多久，就看见前面的食肆之前围了许多人。方言心中一动，凑上前去。食肆一片狼藉，破碎的桌椅板凳散落一地，地上隐隐可见斑斑血迹，掌柜的和伙计正唉声叹气地收拾。“兄台，敢问这是发生了何事？”方言问身旁一个看热闹的路人。那个路人见方言牵着骏马，腰挎长剑，根本不敢怠慢，连忙把他知道的消息说了出来。原来，刚才这里发生了一场大战，五个捕快说是抓捕红花会的反贼，和一对夫妻打了起来。那对夫妻不敌，拼着受伤夺路而逃，已经向西逃出了兰州城，只留下被打坏的食肆。方言心中一凛，果然，剧情已经开始了！方言不想掺和红花会的事情，但是骆冰夫妇已经逃离，自己又不知道千里接龙头的具体位置，根本没办法单独行动。所以方言只能顺着他们的痕迹，一路向西追了过去。好在自己知道这次的地点是在塞外，所以，先赶往边塞重镇安西镇总是没错的。嗯，骆冰夫妇受伤，身后又有追兵，所以必须寻找帮手！红花会千里接龙头，其他几位当家的也会出现，所以只要按照原先既定的路线逃跑，很可能会遇见他们，到时候就能解决身后的追兵！千里接龙头的地点是在塞外，骆冰夫妇必然会出塞！出塞的关口只有这一个，所以骆冰夫妇也只能从这条路走！

简单推理了一下之后，方言确定了追赶的方向，一路沿着官道向西，纵马疾驰而去！又是半个多月的奔驰，途经武威，张掖，酒泉，最终到达了安西重镇外围。在酒泉的时候，方言打听到了骆冰夫妇二人的消息，知道了他们身后的敌人又引来了四名大内侍卫，男的身受重伤，女的两把飞刀废了两个敌人后再次逃走。确定了二人的消息后，方言松了一口气，看来自己没跑错，只要到达安西重镇，自然就能打听到骆冰的消息。这日，方言在路上疾驰，经过一个车队。擦肩而过的时候，突然看见里面的一个老者，胸前配着一朵红花。心下顿觉好笑，这老头快半截儿入土了，还在胸前配红花，是要做新郎官儿吗？策马经过后，顿觉不对劲，红花，红花会，这分明是红花会的信物！方言连忙拨转马头，朝着车队赶去。“前面的朋友，请等一等！”靠近车队后，方言大声喊道。车队里那个戴红花的老者是武当派“绵里针”陆菲青，旁边的姑娘是他的徒弟李沅芷。孙丽版的李沅芷李沅芷的父亲李可秀原是安西镇总兵，带兵有方，精明强干，升任浙江水陆提督。此行，是护送李可秀的家眷前往江南。一听见方言的呼和声，李沅芷就感觉头皮发麻。只道他又是来找茬的江湖人，沧啷一声拔剑出鞘，俏脸含冰，娇斥道：“你又是何人，来找我们……”话说到一半，看见方言一身青色长衫，面若冠玉，脸上虽有风尘之色，却难以掩盖他俊朗的容颜和出尘的气质，当下就是一阵脸热，语气也放缓了许多：“……你来找我们什么事呀？”方言策马来到车队前，勒马后一个抱拳，对着陆菲青施礼道：“不知是红花会哪位英雄当面？可否报上名号？”这个称呼用的十分微妙，红花会的英雄？陆菲青细细思索，有点琢磨不透眼前这个年轻人的来意，要说他是红花会的吧，应当会问“哪位红花会的兄弟当面？”，要说他是清廷的人吧，就不会称呼红花会的为英雄。“小兄弟又是谁？”陆菲青没有说明自身身份，反而提高了警惕。方言一看见他这副样子就知道他误会了。不过这也让方言确认了两点。一，这个老者绝对和红花会有关系，而且是友非敌，否则的话言语里绝对不会有回护之意。二，这个老者绝对见过红花会的人，他胸口的红花也是红花会的人所赠。于是，方言高声答道：“前辈不要紧张，我寻红花会的英雄是有人命关天的大事！不知前辈可见过我四哥奔雷手文泰来夫妇二人？”“哦？你就是方言？”陆菲青一听到方言这么问，立刻就明白了他的身份。在关外客栈救下文泰来夫妇后，他们也和陆菲青提起过方言，请他路上如果碰到的话，就照顾一下。没想到事情就是这么巧，自己和文泰来夫妇分别还不到一天，方言居然就自己找上门来了。

When Fang Yan thought of this, his eyes towards Wen Tailai became much softer.Haha, Wen Tailai, you won't be arrogant for long. When you reach the northwest and leave the fortress, you will be hunted down by the Qing government's lackeys, captured, imprisoned, and tortured. You will have to shed your skin even if you don't die.Fang Yan didn't plan to remind Wen Tailai to pay attention. Firstly, it was because he couldn't explain why he could predict the future. Secondly, because Wen Tailai was stubborn and would never listen to advice, so Fangyan didn't bother with that.The destination of this trip north is beyond the Great Wall, heading northwest from Anxi Town, Gansu Province, to the Western Regions.After nearly a month of living in the open air, traveling through mountains and rivers, driving more than 2,000 kilometers, and crossing more than half of the country, we finally entered Lanzhou, Gansu Province.Fang Yan felt a little desperate at the thought of having to cross the long and narrow territory of Gansu.He had never thought that traveling in ancient times would be such a painful thing.You can only run about two hundred miles a day at most, otherwise the horsepower will be too much.The imaginary excitement of riding horses in the rivers and lakes has all turned into the exhaustion of rushing to stay.Fang Yan was also very ashamed. Although his martial arts skills were higher than those of Wen Tailai and his wife who were traveling with him, he couldn't even compare to Luo Bing when it came to hard work.In this regard, Luo Bing often praises and encourages Fang Yan, saying that there are not many outstanding young people like him!As soon as they entered Lanzhou, Fang Yan was separated from Luo Bing and his wife.The two of them were going to look for traces of the other heads of the Red Flower Club, while Fang Yan was responsible for finding an inn to stay in and replenishing dry food and water bags.After sitting in the inn for a long time, they did not return.Fang Yan waited impatiently, so he took the horse and went out to look for it.Not long after walking in Lanzhou City, I saw many people gathered around the restaurant in front of me.Fang Yan's heart moved and he stepped forward.The restaurant was in a mess, with broken tables, chairs and benches scattered all over the floor, and blood stains faintly visible on the floor. The shopkeeper and the waiter were sighing and cleaning up."Brother, may I ask what happened?" Fang Yan asked a passerby beside him who was watching the excitement.When the passerby saw Fang Yan leading the horse and carrying a long sword at his waist, he didn't dare to neglect him at all and quickly told him the news he knew.It turns out that there was a big fight here just now. Five police officers said they were arresting rebels from the Red Flower Society, and they fought with a couple.The couple was defeated and managed to escape with their injuries. They had already fled westward out of Lanzhou City, leaving only the damaged restaurant behind.Fang Yan was shocked. Sure enough, the plot had already begun!Fang Yan didn't want to get involved in the Red Flower Club's affairs, but Luo Bing and his wife had already fled, and he didn't know the specific location of the Qianli Connector, so he couldn't act alone.So Fang Yan could only follow their traces and chase them westward.Fortunately, I knew that this time the location was outside the Great Wall, so it was always right to rush to Anxi Town, an important border town.Well, Luo Bing and his wife are injured, and there are soldiers chasing behind them, so they must find helpers!Honghua will pick up the leader for thousands of miles, and several other leaders will also appear, so as long as you follow the original route and escape, you are likely to meet them, and then you will be able to deal with the pursuers behind you!The starting point for a thousand-mile journey is outside the Great Wall. Luo Bing and his wife will definitely go out of the Great Wall!There is only one pass out of the fortress, so Luo Bing and his wife can only go through this road!

After a brief reasoning, Fang Yan determined the direction of pursuit, headed west along the official road, and galloped away!It took more than half a month of driving, passing through Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan, and finally arrived at the outskirts of the important town of Anxi.While in Jiuquan, Fang Yan inquired about Luo Bing and his wife, and learned that the enemy behind them had attracted four more Ouchi guards. The man was seriously injured, and the woman crippled two enemies with two flying knives and escaped again.After confirming the news about the two of them, Fang Yan breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that he was right. As long as he arrived at the important town of Anxi, he would naturally be able to find out about Luo Bing.That day, Fang Yan was speeding on the road and passed a convoy.As I was passing by, I suddenly saw an old man inside with a red flower on his chest.I felt funny in my heart. This old man was almost half buried, and he was still wearing red flowers on his chest. Was he going to be a groom?After passing by on horseback, I suddenly felt something was wrong, Honghua, Honghuahui, this is obviously the token of Honghuahui!Fang Yan quickly turned his horse's head and rushed towards the convoy."Friends in front, please wait!" Fang Yan shouted loudly after approaching the motorcade.The old man wearing a red flower in the motorcade is Lu Feiqing, the "Mianli Needle" of the Wudang Sect, and the girl next to him is his apprentice Li Yunzhi.Sun Li's version of Li Yuanzhi Li Kexiu, Li Yuanzhi's father, was originally the commander-in-chief of Anxi Town. He led the troops well, was shrewd and capable, and was promoted to the admiral of land and water in Zhejiang.This trip is to escort Li Kexiu's family to Jiangnan.As soon as she heard the dialect's harmony, Li Yunzhi felt her scalp go numb.They just thought that he was another Jianghu man looking for trouble. He drew his sword out of its scabbard with a clang, his pretty face was icy, and scolded: "Who are you? Come to us..." Halfway through the words, I saw Fang Yan wearing a green gown, with a face like a crown jewel. Although his face had the look of a dusty person, it was difficult to conceal his handsome appearance and aloof temperament. At that momentHis face became hot, and his tone became much slower: "...Why did you come to us?" Fang Yan rode his horse to the front of the convoy, reined in his horse, clasped his fists, and saluted Lu Feiqing: "I wonder which hero of the Red Flower Club is in front of you? Can you tell me your name?" This title is very subtle, hero of the Red Flower Club?Lu Feiqing thought carefully and couldn't figure out the purpose of the young man in front of him. If he was from the Red Flower Club, he would probably ask "Which brother from the Red Flower Club is in front of me?". If he was from the Qing court, he would not call the Red Flower Club a hero."Who is the little brother?" Lu Feiqing did not explain her identity, but instead became more vigilant.Fang Yan knew he had misunderstood as soon as he saw his appearance.But this also allowed Fang Yan to confirm two points.First, this old man is definitely related to Honghua, and he is a friend rather than an enemy. Otherwise, there will never be any intention of protecting him in his words.Second, this old man has definitely met people from the Red Flower Club, and the red flower on his chest was also given by people from the Red Flower Club.So, Fang Yan replied loudly: "Senior, don't be nervous, our search for the heroes of the Red Flower Club is a matter of life and death! I wonder, senior, have you ever seen my fourth brother, Ben Leishou Wen Tailai, and his wife?" "Oh? Are you Fang Yan?" As soon as Lu Feiqing heard Fang Yan ask this, she immediately understood his identity.After rescuing Wen Tailai and his wife at the Guanwai Inn, they also mentioned the dialect to Lu Feiqing and asked him to take care of him if he met him on the way.Unexpectedly, it was such a coincidence that Fang Yan came to our door less than a day after we were separated from Wen Tailai and his wife.
